personal_info.name: Rashad Hamidi
personal_info.title: PhD Researcher in Mathematical and Theoretical Physics

research_interests.description: My primary research interests lie in the areas of integrable systems, string theory and quantum field theory. I am particularly focused on exploring integrable sigma models, their deformations, and their connections to higher-dimensional gauge theories, such as 4d Chern-Simons theory. My work involves studying the mathematical structures underlying these models, including quantum groups and Yang-Baxter equations, as well as investigating their physical applications.
research_interests.vision: My long-term research vision is to implement new technologies such as artificial intelligence, machine learning and quantum computing in theoretical physics research, and use them to discover new integrable field theories.

tasks: Author advanced physics and mathematics problems with step-by-step solutions for model fine-tuning (SFT).
Evaluate and rank model reasoning outputs, isolating mathematical fallacies and hallucinations.
Design adversarial edge cases and evaluation rubrics to benchmark complex multi-step reasoning.
Led engaging and educational guided tours of the observatory facilities for diverse audiences.
Developed and delivered accessible presentations on astronomical concepts and celestial objects.
Operated the main telescope to showcase planets, stars, nebulae, and galaxies during public nights.
Assisted in planning, promotion, and execution of public outreach events (eclipse viewings, meteor showers).
